dataset.name: NIST FR 4019 (Cleary 2003), manufactured home, TN 1455 ch. 6
dataset.use: TEST ONLY - no training, no threshold tuning, no feature selection on NIST

method.model: HistGradientBoosting, same hyper-parameters and episode weights as ai/alarm_verifier/verifier.py
method.training_data: Mendeley Industrial Hall only (active event rows, channel B = CO only)

nist_mapping.nodes: sensor positions A-G (own CO cell); T (ceiling thermocouple), RH probe and particle instrument are single instruments at the kitchen sampling point, shared by all nodes
nist_mapping.particles_primary: TSI 3007 CPC number conc. (p/cm3, >10 nm) - hall counter is optical (>0.3 um); only the log-rise log1p(rise) is used, no rescaling
nist_mapping.baseline: median of all pre-test data (t<0, 1-4 min) instead of 30-min q10
nist_mapping.despike: implausible values -> NaN, trailing 5-sample rolling median, then 10 s bin mean; baseline needs >= 2 pre-test bins
nist_mapping.window: t = 0 (source start) to nominal end of source activity from TN 1455 text
nist_mapping.baseline_detectors: particle threshold log_dPM > 6.9 (hall optical rule); NIST photo sensors >= 0.083 1/m and ion >= 0.033 1/m at any position (TN 1455 table 22, medium sensitivity), sustained 2 consecutive 10 s bins
